description: Adds a contact to a campaign by creating a CampaignMember record to track campaign engagement. Fails if the contact is already a member of the campaign; pre-check membership via SOQL before calling.

campaign_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the campaign to add the contact to.
campaign_id.human_parameter_description: The specific campaign you want to add this contact to. Enter the campaign’s Salesforce ID (often starts with '701') so we know which campaign to update.
campaign_id.title: Campaign Id

contact_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the contact to add to the campaign.
contact_id.human_parameter_description: The person you’re adding to the campaign. Enter the contact’s Salesforce ID (often starts with '003') for the person you want to include.
contact_id.title: Contact Id

custom_fields.description: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values for CampaignMember. Custom field names typically end with '__c'.
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: Provide any custom CampaignMember fields to set. Use the API field name (ending in '__c') as the key.
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

status.description: The status of the campaign member. Common values include 'Sent', 'Responded'. The available statuses depend on campaign configuration. Value must exactly match a configured CampaignMember Status for the campaign; arbitrary strings will fail. Query the campaign's CampaignMemberStatus records first if unsure of valid values.
status.human_parameter_description: How you want this contact to be marked in the campaign (for example, Sent or Responded). This sets their engagement status when they’re added.
status.title: Status

name: add_contact_to_campaign

AddContactToCampaignResponse.description: Response from adding a contact to a campaign in Salesforce.

errors.description: An array of error objects. Empty array when the operation is successful. Contains error details if the operation failed.
errors.title: Errors

id.description: The 18-character Salesforce ID of the newly created CampaignMember record. This ID represents the junction object linking the Contact to the Campaign.
id.title: Id

success.description: Indicates whether the CampaignMember creation was successful. Returns true if the record was created successfully, false otherwise.
success.title: Success

AddContactToCampaignResponse.title: AddContactToCampaignResponse

ErrorDetail.description: Error details from Salesforce API response.

errorCode.description: A specific error code identifier (e.g., MALFORMED_ID, INVALID_INPUT, FIELD_CUSTOM_VALIDATION_EXCEPTION).
errorCode.title: Error Code

fields.description: An optional array containing the API names of fields where the error occurred. Present when validation rules or field-level errors occur.
fields.title: Fields

message.description: A human-readable error message describing what went wrong.
message.title: Message

ErrorDetail.title: ErrorDetail
